title: Fleet Inventory + Rightsizing Recommender with Scenario Simulation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement:
Customers and internal ops teams need actionable recommendations to reduce committed spend on Dedicated pools while preserving throughput SLAs. Existing signals (utilization, slot saturation) are noisy on per-tenant basis and lack scenario simulation (what happens if we shrink N slots or move tenants). This ticket builds an inventory-driven rightsizing recommender that: 1) consolidates fleet and tenant utilization signals, 2) simulates throughput/SLO impact for candidate resize actions, and 3) outputs prioritized, explainable recommendations with rollback-safe plans and a conservative rollout path.

Why this is different from prior work:
- Not just heuristics: introduces an offline simulation engine that replay-weights tenant request patterns against candidate pool configurations.
- Inventory-aware: factors in placement constraints (region, GPU type, private vs hosted) and tenant affinity/anti-affinity.
- Explainability: recommendations include expected cost delta, risk score, and a short checklist of preconditions (cache warming, KV chunk migration).

Goals:
- Reduce committed capacity cost by at least 10% for eligible pools within 2 months of recommendations (internal metric).
- Maintain 99.9th percentile latency SLO for tenants flagged as high-priority.
- Provide UI/exportable CSV that operations can action and a set of safe automation flags for 1-click apply for second-phase rollout.
proposed_solution: Data ingestion: daily snapshot of pool inventory + 1-minute aggregated utilization histogram per tenant (CPU/GPU token/sec, active slots, average batch size).
Signal normalization: convert diverse metrics into a normalized slot-utilization score and burst headroom estimate per tenant
Simulation engine: deterministic replay that applies historical request traces to candidate pool sizes and packing strategies to estimate throughput and tail-latency impact
Risk scoring: combine simulated SLO violations, migration cost (KV cache warmup penalty), and tenant SLA tier to create a 0-100 risk index
Recommendation generator: rank candidate actions (reduce X slots, consolidate into pool Y, change autoscale min/max) with expected monthly cost delta and risk score
Output: API + CSV export + Console view with filter by region/model/pool-type and an apply plan that creates a change ticket with prechecks
implementation_notes: Start with a lightweight simulator that uses sampled 1h traces to bound compute costs; optimize to use incremental simulation later
Reuse existing fleet telemetry paths (see ENG-4821 and ENG-58209) to avoid duplicative exports
Kubernetes-level actions are out of scope for this ticket; produce an operator-ready plan for the infra team to execute or for an ops UI to call
Preserve per-tenant KV cache affinity: recommendations must warn when cache re-warm is expected > 5% latency regressions
Add feature flag to gate automatic apply; initial release is advisory-only
acceptance_criteria: Service exports a ranked recommendations CSV for at least 3 dedicated pools (multi-region) with expected cost delta and risk score
Simulator reports P99 latency delta per recommendation and flags any recommendation that increases P99 by > 1.5x
Docs: short runbook for operators describing how to validate a recommendation and required prechecks
Unit tests for simulator core path and integration tests against synthetic traces
Console prototype displays recommendations and links to generated change tickets
metrics_to_track: Post-action SLO violation delta (P95/P99) for affected tenants
False-positive rate: percentage of applied recommendations that required rollback within 48h
Time to generate recommendations (target < 30m for full fleet run)
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal): run advisory-only on staging fleets, validate simulator accuracy against a holdout week
Phase 1 (pilot): expose recommendations for 3 volunteer customers and ops teams; collect feedback and safe failures
Phase 2 (ops-assisted): enable export CSV and one-click create change ticket in ops queue; require manual approval
Phase 3 (automation): gated opt-in for auto-apply with conservative cooldowns and canaries (25% of recommendations per week)
risks_and_mitigations: Simulator drift vs production: mitigate with periodic calibration using real after-action metrics
Tenant cache-warm cost underestimated: include migration cost estimate and require manual approval for high-risk actions
Over-optimization on short-term troughs: require min-observation-window (30d) and churn-resistance heuristics
Cross-pool packing conflicts: surface constraints in recommendations and provide a manual consolidation approval flow
notes: UX spike: coordinate with Design on how to present risk scores and migration timelines
Meetings: sync with capacity-planning team on 2026-03-05 produced the initial dataset schema
